mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park, and the moon is in the new phase. Look up tonight at 6:30 PM to catch the space station as it passes from the south southwest toward the east northeast, reaching halfway up the sky.

The Mark Drive reconstruction project is entering phase two, with contractors focusing on concrete curbs and sidewalks. Please note that work is weather dependent, but the city expects to wrap up concrete installation this month.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In police news, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
